duel_insert.name: duel_insert
duel_insert.withCheck: "duels"."challenger_id" = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and exists (select 1 from friendships f where f.status = 'accepted' and ((f.requester_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and f.addressee_id = "duels"."opponent_id") or (f.addressee_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and f.requester_id = "duels"."opponent_id")))
